artDirection: GOCHUJANG — "Fermented Editorial." One unbroken visual grade across every surface: warm-charcoal ground (#161210 / clay #1A1310), bone paper (#F5EFE6), and a single gochujang crimson→persimmon ember (#C63A20→#E8542E→#F0873F) that carries 100% of the color heat. The photographic language is CLOSE, CHARRED, and GLOSSY — macro crops that read texture first (char, steam, sheen, ferment funk, crumb), never wide styled tablescapes with props and negative-space plates. Every food image is warm-graded (push warmth, deepen shadows to charcoal, protect the crimson channel so red food glows) and grain-dusted so heterogeneous Unsplash stock fuses into one branded, print-magazine system. Two tiers of treatment: TIER 1 (hero + primary dish shots + featured spotlight) stays FULL COLOR under the warm grade so the food is mouth-watering; TIER 2 (category tiles, thumbnails, portraits, story cards, backgrounds) gets the charcoal+ember DUOTONE so it recedes into brand and never competes with a Tier-1 focal image on the same screen. Nothing is ever a raw : every slot sits on a palette-derived fallbackGradient + seeded local SVG so a CDN miss reveals intentional brand art, not a broken box. The imagery is the luxury; the SVG graphic layer (grain, gradient-mesh, ember drop, category glyphs, chili SpiceMeter, passport seals) is the guaranteed-render "highly graphic" spine that renders in KB with zero network dependency and looks deliberate offline. Cohesion is enforced by four constants applied identically everywhere: (1) the same warm grade, (2) the same ~5-6% film grain, (3) the same bottom-anchored charcoal legibility scrim under any text, (4) the same 20px card radius and 4:3 / 3:2 focal crops. The result reads premium in 50ms, stays effortless to read for hours, and never once resembles the old static tracker.

graphicAssets.name: film-grain-texture
graphicAssets.description: 256x256 tileable SVG using feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.9, numOctaves 2, feColorMatrix to monochrome, output as a repeating fixed overlay. mix-blend-mode: overlay. The single most important cohesion asset — sits over every dark surface and every full-bleed/duotone image.
graphicAssets.palette: Neutral monochrome noise; opacity 0.04 on bone light surfaces (#F5EFE6), 0.06 on charcoal dark (#161210)
graphicAssets.usage: Global fixed overlay on hero, all cards, category tiles, story cards, portraits, marquee band, newsletter/press bands. Frozen (static) under prefers-reduced-motion. Kills flat digital emptiness, adds print-magazine tactility, guarantees render offline.

cohesionRules: ONE WARM GRADE EVERYWHERE: every food photo is pushed warm, shadows deepened toward charcoal (#161210), and the red/crimson channel protected so gochujang food glows. No cool-blue, no flat-neutral, no high-key bright-white shots survive the grade — this single rule makes 15+ mismatched Unsplash sources read as one commissioned shoot.

TWO TIERS, NEVER MORE THAN ONE TIER-1 PER SCREEN: Tier 1 (full-color warm-grade) is reserved for the hero, the dish-detail hero, the Home featured spotlight, and the DishCard hover state — the mouth-watering focal image. Everything else (category tiles, thumbnails, portraits, story cards, pairings, backgrounds) is Tier 2 charcoal+ember duotone so it recedes into brand. Only one full-color focal image competes for the eye on any given screen.

GRAIN IS UNIVERSAL AND CONSTANT: the same feTurbulence film grain (0.04 light / 0.06 dark, mix-blend overlay) sits over every surface and every image at the same opacity. It is the tactile print-magazine glue and the offline-render guarantee. Freeze it, never remove it, under reduced-motion.

NEVER A RAW IMG — THE FALLBACK IS THE DESIGN: every SmartImage renders its palette-derived fallbackGradient + the seeded generative-hero-mesh + grain BEHIND the ; onError hides the photo and keeps the gradient. A CDN miss must reveal intentional brand art, never a broken box. Aspect-ratio boxes reserve every slot so CLS stays <0.1 whether the photo loads or fails.

ONE FOCAL DISCIPLINE: every food crop is CLOSE and TEXTURAL — char, steam, gloss, ferment funk, crumb — focal point placed off-center (rule-of-thirds) so a bottom-anchored scrim and overlaid type always have a clean landing zone. No wide styled tablescapes, no prop clutter, no empty-plate minimalism.

CRIMSON BY SCARCITY: the gochujang crimson→persimmon ember (#C63A20→#E8542E→#F0873F) appears as a spot accent only — CTAs, the wordmark ember drop, active states, SpiceMeter, key labels, and the fallback gradients. It is never a background wash on content surfaces and never used as small colored text on light paper (fails contrast). Its rarity is what keeps it loud.

ONE SCRIM RECIPE FOR ALL TEXT-ON-IMAGE: any text over photography sits on the same bottom-anchored grad-duotone-ink scrim (rgba(18,12,9,0) → rgba(18,12,9,0.92) over the lower ~45%), plus a 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) text-shadow as belt-and-suspenders. Measured composited luminance under text stays ≤0.18 for white — a flat 55% veil is never enough over bright dishes.

ONE CORNER LANGUAGE: 20px radius on all cards (radius-card), 14px on glyphs/medallions, pill on chips/CTAs, 28px on modals — applied identically to photos, SVG assets, and UI so the whole system shares a silhouette.

DUOTONE MAP IS SHARED, HUE IS PER-CATEGORY: all Tier 2 imagery runs through the one reusable duotone-svg-filter; only the highlight hue swaps by category (ember default, plum for fermented/funk, amber for noodles, celadon for fresh/rice, rose for sweet-heat). Same engine, coordinated accents — variety without fragmentation.

SVG GRAPHIC LAYER CARRIES THE 'HIGHLY GRAPHIC' PUNCH, NOT PNGs: grain, mesh, brand mark, category glyphs, chili units, passport seals, radar, dividers all ship as local inline SVG (KB not MB, zero network dependency). Photography supplies appetite; the SVG spine supplies the guaranteed graphic identity that renders even with images.unsplash.com fully blocked.

FONT + NUMBER COHESION: Fraunces (display serif) on every headline, pull-quote and oversized numeral; Geist (sans) on all UI/body/metadata; Geist Mono tabular-nums on every stat, timer, Scoville, servings and streak count — the instrument-panel voice that contrasts the warm serif and reads consistently across all five routes.

STATE IS NEVER COLOR-ALONE: spice level, active filter, wouldCookAgain, batch status, and ratings each carry a second cue (icon/weight/underline/fill/label). Meters and gauges keep filled vs empty ≥3:1 apart, and all data-viz graphics (radar strokes, ring tracks, gauge arcs) clear 3:1 against their ground in BOTH themes.

COHESION VALIDATED IN BOTH THEMES: every treatment, scrim, and fallback is checked in light (bone) and dark (charcoal) — the warm grade, grain opacity, duotone map and accent scarcity hold identically so the site feels like one product whether viewed in light or dark mode.
overlayTreatments: Bottom-anchored legibility scrim (grad-duotone-ink): linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18,12,9,0) 0%, rgba(18,12,9,0.72) 70%, rgba(18,12,9,0.92) 100%) over the lower ~45% of every text-bearing image; the mandatory belt for hero, DishCard foot, story cards and dish-detail hero.

Charcoal+ember duotone (Tier 2 default): feColorMatrix/gradientMap shadows→#161210, highlights→#E8542E — the unifying grade for all secondary imagery; full color reserved for Tier 1 focal shots and DishCard hover.
Plum-funk duotone variant: shadows→#3A1C2E, mids→#5E2A3E, highlights→#8A3A2C — for all Fermented & Funky imagery and umami/ferment editorial bands (grad-plum-funk).

Celadon fresh duotone/wash variant: #1F3A30 → #3E7C63 → #7FBF9E — for Rice & Bowls, herbaceous collections, Flavor Passport and 'batch ready' success states; its coolness makes adjacent crimson read hotter.

Warm-grade color-correct (Tier 1): push warmth, deepen shadows toward charcoal, protect/boost the red channel so gochujang food glows; the single grade applied to every full-color food shot for shoot-level consistency.
Film-grain overlay: tiled feTurbulence noise, mix-blend-mode overlay, opacity 0.04 light / 0.06 dark — over every surface and every image, frozen under reduced-motion.
Inner vignette (shadow-inset-dark): inset 0 0 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55) on hero and duotone image frames to focus the eye and seat the image into the charcoal ground.
Text-shadow belt-and-suspenders: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) on any text over imagery — a secondary legibility guarantee, never the primary mechanism.

Palette fallback gradient + generative-mesh under-layer: every SmartImage carries its slot's fallbackGradient plus the seeded SVG mesh + grain behind the photo so a CDN miss renders intentional brand art.

Edge duotone bleed on hero: crimson→charcoal duotone feathered into the frame edges of the full-color hero so the accent color reaches the viewport corners and the image seats seamlessly into the charcoal page ground.
Grad-paper-sheen (light) / grad-ember-radial (dark) band wash: for newsletter, press and social-proof strips — warm paper depth or molten glow behind mono type, always dusted with the same grain.
